get.summary: Liveness: the process is running.

Readiness: both database logins answer and partitions exist 7 days ahead;

Both, because the API signs in twice. Everything the site renders uses the
api login, and Better Auth uses its own, and only the second one can sign
anybody in. Checking one and reporting "ok" is how a deployment with a bad
DB_AUTH_PASSWORD served every page perfectly while no one could log in.
The public page at vrc.page/<slug>. Private, hidden, held and unknown names are one identical 404.

Who can open one of this account's pages. Owners only: an editor could
otherwise unpublish a community's page. A page this account doesn't run
is the same 404 as one that isn't there.

Disconnect VRChat. The page goes, and so do the groups claimed through
that connection and their pages; every name is held for 90 days.

get.summary:
Whether a name can be used. Signed in, because a stranger has no business
mapping which names exist. `pageId` names the page asking, so its own name
comes back as "yours" rather than "taken".

put.summary:
Give one of this account's pages its name, or change it. Owners only. The
first name is free; after a change the name settles for slug.change_cooldown_days,
and the one it replaced is held so nobody can pick it up to pass as its owner.

post.summary:
Read the page again from VRChat now, rather than waiting for its turn.
Owners only, one manual refresh per page per refresh.manual.cooldown_seconds,
and refresh.manual.daily_cap_per_account a day.

info.title: vrc.page API
info.description: The backend for vrc.page. Errors use RFC 9457 Problem Details (application/problem+json), and every response carries an X-Request-Id header.

tags.name: health
tags.description: Liveness and readiness probes for load balancers and uptime checks.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Sign-in, sessions and account settings, on Better Auth. The session cookie belongs to the website, which forwards it.

tags.name: me
tags.description: The signed-in account's own pages and settings, for the dashboard.

tags.name: dev
tags.description: Development only: test-data shortcuts. Not registered in production.

email.description: The address to send the code to.

botCheckToken.description: The Turnstile token from the sign-in form's widget.

pendingToken.description:
The address, dated when its code went out and signed:
`<sent at ms>.<signature>.<email>`. Keep it (the website uses an httpOnly
cookie) and hand it back to resend without another bot check. Valid as
long as the code.

sent.description: False inside the resend cooldown: the code sent moments ago still stands.

resendIn.description: Seconds before another code can be sent.

code.description: The digits from the email; anything else in it is ignored.

callbackURL.description: A path on the website, such as /dashboard.

errorCallbackURL.description: A path on the website; the provider's `error` is added to its query.

callbackURL.description: A path on the website; on failure it gets an `error` query parameter.

email.description: The account's own address, for its settings. Never shown anywhere public.

resendIn.description: Seconds before another code can be sent to this address.

slug.description: The group's own vrc.page, only while that page is public.

label.description: The label its owner gave it, for links added on vrc.page.

source.description: vrchat: from the VRChat bio or group. vrcpage: added on vrc.page.

url.description: An absolute https URL. Never rendered as markup.

adult.description: Marked 18+ by its owner. Always false for VRChat's links; the website also treats OnlyFans and Fansly as 18+.

bio.description: Plain text with its line breaks.

bannerUrl.description: Our own copy, never a VRChat address. Null until images are stored.

links.description: VRChat's first, then the ones added on vrc.page, in their order.

verifiedAt.description: When the bio code matched: ISO 8601.

lastRefreshedAt.description: Last successful read from VRChat: ISO 8601.

slug.description: The owner's own vrc.page, only while that page is public.

shortCode.description: Shown with the discriminator as ABCDE.1234, the code VRChat uses.

url.description: Where anybody can watch it: https://vrcdn.live/preview/<name>.

live.description:
Its streams that are live right now, VRCDN's for now. Asked of each
stream at most every 30 seconds. Always empty from /v1/showcase.

alias.description: The name asked for is an alias of `slug`.

redirect.description: An alias that sends the visitor on to `slug` (308). False for the page's own name, and for an alias that shows the page at itself.

slug.description: Null until a name is chosen.

id.description: vrc.page's page id, used in dashboard addresses.

vrchatId.description: The usr_ or grp_ id, which seeds the fallback colour.

roles.description: Staff roles this account holds. An admin may run every page, with no waits.

groupClaimsLeft.description: More groups this account may still claim.

groups.description: Owned groups first, then the ones this account edits.

nameChangeableAt.description: When the page's name may next change: ISO 8601, or null when it can now.

refreshableAt.description: When it may next be refreshed from VRChat by hand: ISO 8601, or null when it can now.

nameChangeableAt.description: When the page's name may next change: ISO 8601, or null when it can now.

refreshableAt.description: When it may next be refreshed from VRChat by hand: ISO 8601, or null when it can now.

groupInvites.description: Someone invited you to edit a group.

pageChanges.description: Your page's name, visibility or links changed.

status.description: available: free. yours: this page already has it. taken: another page has it. held: released recently and still held. reserved: a name the site keeps. impersonation: contains a blocked word. invalid: not letters, digits, _ or -.

invitedBy.description: Who asked, by their VRChat name.

name.description: Their VRChat name, or null if they have disconnected VRChat since.

slug.description: Their own page, if it has a name.

id.description:
This account, as this group's owner may refer to it. Opaque: it is only
ever used to take the seat away again.

since.description: When they took the seat, or when they were asked: ISO 8601.

pending.description: An invitation nobody has answered yet.

max.description: Seats and waiting invitations together may not pass this.

editors.description: Seats taken, then invitations still waiting.

name.description: Their vrc.page name, as in vrc.page/<name>.

adult.description: Marked 18+. Visitors confirm before it opens.

max.description: Links one page may add, from links.custom.max_per_page.

enabled.description: False when adding links is turned off for everyone.

adult.description: Marks the link 18+. Defaults to false.

url.description: What was typed. A missing scheme means https; anything else is refused.

checksLeft.description: Checks left before the code is spent and a new one is needed.

checkIn.description: Seconds until "Check now" works again; 0 when it does.

targetId.description: The usr_ or grp_ id being claimed.

displayName.description: Whose account, or which group, so nobody claims the wrong one.

code.description: vrcpage- and the code to paste into the bio or description.

link.description: vrchat.com/home/user/usr_… or vrchat.com/home/group/grp_…, or the id on its own.

status.description: matched: claimed. no_match: the code is not there yet. cooldown: too soon. read_failed: nothing came back, and no check was spent (reason busy means vrc.page has not got a turn to ask yet). refused: the code matched but the claim is not allowed. expired or exhausted: start again.

reason.description: Why the read failed, or why the claim was refused.

pageId.description: The page that now exists, when the code matched.

claim.description: Where the claim stands, while it is still open.

vrchatName.description: The connected VRChat account's display name, or null before one is connected.

pageId.description: Its own page's id and name, when it has one.

next.description: Pass as `before` for the next, older, page of results; null at the end.

name.description: The VRChat display name or group name.
Can be empty: an email sign-up has no name.

sessions.description: Sessions that haven't expired, newest first.

pages.description: Its own page, then the groups it owns.

editing.description: Groups it helps run as an editor.

name.description: Up to 200 characters. Empty clears it.

next.description: Pass as `before` for the next, older, page of results; null at the end.

redirect.description: True sends the visitor on to the page's own name; false shows the page here.

showcase.description: Picked as an example for the home page. Only shown there while it is public.

reason.description: Why, for staff. Up to 1000 characters.

redirect.description: Defaults to true: the alias sends visitors on to the page's own name.

bio.description: Where a vrcpage- code is looked for.

description.description: Where a vrcpage- code is looked for.

reads.description: How reads answer: normally, or as VRChat does when it pushes back.

retryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before trying again, for a cooldown.

at.description: Which item of a submitted list the problem is about, counting from 0.

type.description:
A URI naming the kind of problem: "about:blank" when the status says it
all, otherwise https://vrc.page/problems/<code>, with a code from
src/common/problem.ts.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the kind of problem.

detail.description: What went wrong this time, in words a person can act on.

instance.description: The path of the request that failed.

requestId.description: Same as the X-Request-Id response header and the request's audit log entries.
